content.title: A Dissertation on Miracles (1762)
content.author: George Campbell
content.note: The first full reply to Hume's essay on miracles, by a Scottish minister Hume himself respected. For testimony, experience and the limits of Hume's argument. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translator or edition named and an exact locator.
